input: Research local ice climbing introductory sessions

gold.taskTitle: Research Local Ice Climbing Introductory Sessions
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate nearby introductory ice climbing sessions or courses to attend.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic area to search for local ice climbing sessions.

questions.title: Have you ever climbed before, ice or otherwise?
questions.description: Understand the user's existing climbing background to match appropriate beginner sessions.

questions.title: What is your target timeframe for attending a session?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to go this weekend, this season, or has a flexible timeline.

questions.title: Are you looking for a guided one-day intro or a multi-day course?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred format and depth of instruction the user is seeking.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this activity?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints so options can be filtered by price range.

questions.title: Will you be attending solo or bringing others along?
questions.description: Determine group size to identify sessions that accommodate individuals or groups.

questions.title: Do you need gear rental included or do you have your own?
questions.description: Find out whether the session must provide equipment such as crampons, ice axes, and helmets.
